law: Every runtime input enumerated, typed, owned, sourced. Secrets declare an injection channel and never enter the repo, the JSONL state, or logs. Per-env deltas are bindings, not code flags.

inputs.name: electron.userData
inputs.default: OS per-user app-data dir for 'ADCOS' (e.g. ~/.config/ADCOS on Linux)
inputs.notes: Parent of the state store and the append-only main.log. Single-instance lock is per user session.

inputs.name: surfaces.statePath
inputs.allowedValues: any writable file path; append-only JSONL
inputs.notes: THE durable control-plane state. Journey events only; opaque payment references per ADR-0004 (never live payment data). Restore drill: ops/drills/restore-drill.md.

inputs.name: surfaces.operatorPrincipals
inputs.allowedValues: principal ids (honest local demo identities in the shipped app)
inputs.notes: Deployment configuration, not runtime state (surfaces contract law). Grants the operator aggregate view.

inputs.name: surfaces.developerPrincipals
inputs.allowedValues: principal ids (honest local demo identities in the shipped app)
inputs.notes: Deployment configuration, not runtime state. Grants the developer contract surface view.

inputs.name: surfaces.now
inputs.allowedValues: any injected clock; fixed clocks in tests/drills
inputs.notes: Injected clock law — no ambient time inside the domain.

inputs.name: desktop.rendererAssets
inputs.allowedValues: file:// URLs only, by construction (will-navigate guard; window-open denied)
inputs.notes: Product lock: no remote URL can ever be loaded; the ZCode substrate is unreachable.

inputs.name: release.channel
inputs.allowedValues: any published release tag on payswapdotorg/adcos-2.0
inputs.notes: Assets: adcos-desktop_<v>_amd64.deb, adcos-desktop-<v>-x86_64.AppImage, SHA256SUMS.md, INSTALL-UBUNTU.md — anonymous download, SHA256-verified.

inputs.name: build.ELECTRON_MIRROR
inputs.consumer: build host only (electron binary download during pnpm install)
inputs.notes: Build-time only; never ships in the product.

inputs.name: publish.GITHUB_TOKEN
inputs.consumer: release publishing only (electron-builder publish / gh release flows at the integration station)
inputs.channel: environment variable of the publishing host (never the repo; never a file in the tree)
inputs.allowedValues: GitHub PAT with repo write scope
inputs.notes: The ONLY secret in the product's lifecycle. check-secrets.mjs fails the release gate if a ghp_/github_pat_ literal appears in tracked files.

inputs.name: substrate.config/*
inputs.consumer: substrate (NOT the shipped product): packages/web, packages/desktop, zcode-cli
inputs.notes: Inherited ZCode substrate config. NOT consumed by product-web/desktop-adcos (verified by import scan). Listed for scope honesty only.

adr0004.law: Live provider / hardware integration and payment-rail selection are BLOCKED-ON-OPERATOR (spec/adr/ADR-0004-payment-references.md).
adr0004.environmentConsequence: No environment binding in this file may reference live provider credentials or live payment rails. The shipped environments carry NO such inputs by construction.
